cases.name: Peggy Ann Brown
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She graduated from Columbus North High School and attended Tufts University in Somerville, MA and Indiana University in Bloomington, IN, earning her bachelor's degree there. Peggy's first marriage was to Curt DeClue of Columbus, IN and they had one daughter, Sarah Josephine. After a divorce from Curt, Peggy married Thomas Boggs of Columbus, IN. They lived in Massachusetts, then New Hampshire while raising Sarah and their daughter, Erin Rebecca.

Peggy primarily worked in human resources while raising her children. In 2005, Peggy went back to school to earn her master's degree in social work from Simmons University in Boston, MA. After seeing her father's experience in hospice, she was passionate about providing the best care for people at the end of their lives.

Her family and friends remember Peggy for her great sense of humor, intelligence, compassion, and warmth toward all. She was a loving and devoted daughter, wife, mother, grandmother, sister, friend and so much more.

Peggy loved watching and supporting sports teams, whether it was her daughters' or grandsons', her beloved New England Patriots or her alma mater, the Indiana Hoosiers. She also loved doing puzzles, reading, crafts, and socializing with friends and family where you could always hear her amazing laugh and depend on her attentive listening. People were drawn to her caring way, timely advice, and the personal attention she would give each and every person.

She was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease shortly after her husband, Tom, died in 2018. After Tom's death, she began a partnership with Douglas Lyon of New London, NH who had been a lifelong friend of both Tom and Peggy. Doug and Peggy had a loving, committed relationship through the end of her life."
